summary.text: Joshua Hoover, listed by Ballotpedia as Josh Hoover, is a Republican member of the California State Assembly from District 7 who took office on December 5, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hoover defeated incumbent Ken Cooley in the 2022 general election for Assembly District 7 and won re-election on November 5, 2024, defeating Democrat Porsche Middleton, 53.6 percent to 46.4 percent.
In the June 2, 2026 primary he received 50.9 percent and advanced to the general election against Democrat Amy Slavensky, who received 47.2 percent.

For 2025 and 2026 he was vice chair of the Communications and Conveyance Committee and the Education Committee, and a member of the Local Government, Natural Resources and Transportation committees and the Legislative Audit Committee.
